title.narrative: Development of digital skills and competencies of Central African populations through media and information literacy (MIL)

description.narrative: In January 2024, internet penetration in Central African countries was around 38.85%, with mobile penetration at 71.12% and a growth rate of 49.11% in internet users. By 2030, the mobile phone penetration rate is expected to reach 80%, with 4G coverage at 48% across all ECCAS countries. These advancements in ICT offer hope for digitization and development in Central Africa. However, there is a lack of user preparedness, resulting in potential harm from ICT usage. Current and potential crises in several countries are exploiting the internet, media, social networks, and AI to spread disinformation and hate speech. Priority actions to address this are: Development of national policies and strategies; MIL in media & digital platforms; countering hate speech and misinformation; and responding to the use of generative AI and MIL in youth organizations. Activities encompass providing technical support and policy advice to ECCAS commission and Member States, promoting regional media networks, and conducting capacity building events for youth organizations to integrate MIL into their operations in Central Africa.
